title: Finite BIT construction: R438 source boundary with full hosted invoice
body:
The selected PR589 R439 word keeps helper470 for one late read after source77
has entered frame186. At that actual caller boundary, source77 is unchanged
and receiver444 can enter frame186 before its next gate. This construction
reads source77 directly, deletes helper470, rebuilds literal C and dirty-target
D, and recounts the complete nine-stage hosted schedule on the same upstream
word.

The result is R438, **24,305 → 24,248 local ADDs** and
**904,896 → 904,320 paid recursive children**. The full exact bit invoice
improves **c = 0.001733427039589844234749 → 0.001734176288479865766692**.
All returned idle rank, source access, restoration, copied totals and helper
occupancy are paid. Live stock and precision allowances are unchanged.
**No new kappa:** the selected complex supplier still binds.

Validation includes every dirty local column, original H1-H5, independent
literal records, original C++ legality and 5/9/11-stage checks on both words,
96 omitted-bridge controls, both complete parent and residual-hosting audits,
and two exact moment engines. Six new controls reject source-lifetime,
frame, restoration, compensation and omitted-idle-charge defects. Full paths,
source pins, exact certificate, proof and reproduction command are in
`research/bit-boundary-persistence/`.

```sh
BOOST_INCLUDE=/opt/homebrew/include python3 -I -B research/bit-boundary-persistence/verify.py --output /tmp/r438-source-boundary
```

Base `8bddbee377e2f3ce1f1247196c4b290d55767d20`. Only this research package
is added. PR980/1001/1015 retain R439; this result leaves B unchanged and changes
one source-access path and helper stock. Their savings are not composed.
Source inlining and early retirement are prior ideas; the contribution is this
legal boundary and its complete paid invoice, not general mechanism priority.

The all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, correlated
whole-call hosting, tape/precision and analytic assumptions remain inherited.
The cover is compressed, not astronomically enumerated. The inherited invoice
also runs historical cited PR548 outer arithmetic; the selected complex cold
replay and full selected assembly are not claimed. No practical speedup,
full-theorem formal proof, unrestricted optimum or remote CI pass is claimed.

Credit eumemic, DreamingOfClouds, Dylan Crow, DaysSky, chafreaky, Zhihao Chen
and the retained E8 supplier lineage. Prepared for Ali Romman (@aliromman),
with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, under Apache-2.0. No independent
human review is implied.

The coordinator reviewed all new code and the proof, then independently replayed the dirty-column boundary and local controls, the nine-stage native binary, the complete residual-host audit, and the exact supplier invoice. The final invoice matched the saved result.
